title: Estágio em administração
description:
Ficamos felizes pelo seu interesse em participar da nossa equipe de colaboradores, que já soma aproximadamente 5.500 funcionários.
Antes de sabermos mais sobre suas características profissionais, convidamos você a conhecer um pouco da história da Santa Casa da
Bahia, instituição filantrópica que se propõe ao objetivo de ajudar aos mais necessitados.
Foi no ano de 1549, quando Tomé de Sousa ocupava o posto de governador-geral do Brasil, que foi construída uma casa de taipa e palha, no Centro Histórico de Salvador, que por cerca de 200 anos abrigou o Hospital de Caridade, primeiro hospital do Estado da Bahia, sendo o único a prestar assistência aos baianos na época.
Somente em 30 de julho de 1893 foi construído o Hospital Santa Izabel (HSI), no bairro de Nazaré, em Salvador, desativando a antiga
unidade de saúde que funcionava no Pelourinho. O prédio do primeiro hospital passou a ser a sede administrativa da Santa Casa da Bahia e, em 2006, se tornou o Museu da Misericórdia.
A Santa Casa da Bahia é uma associação beneficente de assistência social, que se propõe ao exercício da caridade e prestação de
serviços nas áreas de saúde, ensino, pesquisa, cultura, assistência social e educação, sem subordinação ao Estado ou à Igreja.
*A Santa Casa da Bahia NÃO solicita valores para nenhuma situação que envolva oportunidade de emprego, tampouco solicita PIX para realização de cursos para vagas de emprego ou envio de dados pessoais por mensagens. Nosso único meio para recebimento de currículos é através da plataforma Gupy, assim como todas as etapas do processo admissional, ambas situações acessadas com login e senha cadastrados pelo próprio usuário, enquanto cliente da plataforma.*

title: Junior business analyst
description:
Driving lasting impact and building long-term capabilities with our clients is not easy work. You are the kind of person who thrives in a high performance/high reward culture - doing hard things, picking yourself up when you stumble, and having the resilience to try another way forward.
In return for your drive, determination, and curiosity, we'll provide the resources, mentorship, and opportunities you need to become a stronger leader faster than you ever thought possible. Your colleagues—at all levels—will invest deeply in your development, just as much as they invest in delivering exceptional results for clients. Every day, you'll receive apprenticeship, coaching, and exposure that will accelerate your growth in ways you won’t find anywhere else.
When you join us, you will have:
Continuous learning:  Our learning and apprenticeship culture, backed by structured programs, is all about helping you grow while creating an environment where feedback is clear, actionable, and focused on your development. The real magic happens when you take the input from others to heart and embrace the fast-paced learning experience, owning your journey. A voice that matters:  From day one, we value your ideas and contributions. You’ll make a tangible impact by offering innovative ideas and practical solutions, all while upholding our unwavering commitment to ethics and integrity. We not only encourage diverse perspectives, but they are critical in driving us toward the best possible outcomes. Global community:  With colleagues across 65+ countries and over 100 different nationalities, our firm’s diversity fuels creativity and helps us come up with the best solutions for our clients. Plus, you’ll have the opportunity to learn from exceptional colleagues with diverse backgrounds and experiences. World-class benefits:  On top of a competitive salary (based on your location, experience, and skills), we provide a comprehensive benefits package to enable holistic well-being for you and your family.
You’ll work in teams of typically 3–5 consultants, playing an active role in all aspects of client engagement.  
This includes gathering and analyzing information, formulating and testing hypotheses, and developing and communicating recommendations. You’ll also have the opportunity to present results to client management and implement recommendations in collaboration with client team members. Some examples of the specific work may include interviewing clients, leading client teams, building financial models, and working with Mc Kinsey subject experts to develop perspectives and insights for the client. In some cases, you will be asked to travel to your client site. 
When you join Mc Kinsey, you are joining a firm that will invest in your professional development. You will participate in an introductory training program, as well as a range of social activities to get to know your office and the firm. 
As a Junior Business Analyst, you will receive training and coaching on how to better:

Structure ambiguous problems and take action to solve them
Synthesize clear takeaways from complex information into clear takeaways and recommendations using both qualitative and quantitative methods
Work effectively with diverse teams to come up with the best solution and move people and organizations to act
Establish trust-based relationships with clients to better serve their organizations
Communicate effectively with all audiences, including senior leaders, in a structured manner
Develop your leadership style, leveraging your own passions, strengths, and personal values Mc Kinsey believes in strengths-based development and coaching, and you’ll receive frequent mentoring from colleagues. This will include: 

Engagement colleagues and leadership who will provide feedback regularly to help you improve your daily performance
A professional development manager who manages staffing to help you choose projects based on your priorities as well as the needs of client service teams
A senior colleague from your office or practice who will help you grow and achieve your career goals At the end of your Junior Business Analyst program, you may receive an offer to become a Business Analyst.
As a Junior Business Analyst, you will join our Rio de Janeiro or Sao Paulo office to work in teams and directly with our clients. This 6 to 24-month program was created to develop talents into real leaders through research, training, mentoring, and coaching sessions. 
Your team colleagues will make you feel welcome and help you be at your best during client engagements. The Professional Development team will complement your experience by tailoring a learning and training program for you, considering your strengths and development needs. 
In this role you will have the opportunity to work on teams and help the best organizations in the world – across the private, public, and social sectors – solve some of their most difficult problems, while you discover coaches, mentors, sponsors and friends in your learning program.

Undergraduate degree in any course, except business administration, economics and engineering
Graduation between Dec 2022 and Jul 2026
Ability to communicate ideas most effectively – both verbally and in writing – in English and Portuguese
Ability to break down and solve problems through quantitative thinking and analysis
Capability to drive an independent workstream in the context of a broader team project
Ability to work collaboratively in a team and create an inclusive environment with people at all levels of an organization
Comfort with ambiguous, ever-changing situations

title: Analista de franquias

Nós somos a Essilor Luxottica, líder global no design, fabricação e distribuição de lentes oftálmicas, armações e óculos de sol. A empresa reúne a expertise complementar de dois pioneiros da indústria, um em tecnologias avançadas de lentes e outro na arte da fabricação de óculos icônicos, criando um negócio verticalmente integrado, única e exclusivamente posicionado para atender às necessidades de visão em constante evolução do mundo e à demanda global de uma indústria de óculos em crescimento.​ ​ Com mais de 180.000 colaboradores em 150 países impulsionando nossas marcas icônicas, nossas pessoas são criativas, empreendedoras e reconhecidas por suas perspectivas e individualidades únicas. Comprometidos com a visão, nós capacitamos as pessoas a "verem mais e serem mais" graças aos nossos designs inovadores e tecnologias de lentes, qualidade excepcional e métodos de processamento de ponta. Todos os dias impactamos a vida de milhões de pessoas ao mudar a maneira como elas veem o mundo.​
Quais serão as minhas atividades e responsabilidades? Responsável pela execução das estratégias comercias e operacionais na rede franqueada, atuando no abastecimento da rede e implantação de processos operacionais e de venda, visando atingimento dos resultados, crescimento de suas lojas, expansão de portfolio, bem como a manutenção dos padrões da marca a fim de elevar a exposição da marca Carol/produtos Luxottica e o nível de satisfação da rede e clientes com o negócio.
Atuar como consultor de negócio, expondo as melhores praticas da rede, bem como orientar o franqueado sobre a perfeita execução do ponto de venda, visando crescimento do negócio e da marca Óticas Carol.
Realizar o diagnóstico da operação do franqueado, avaliando Mix, execução de Vm, indicadores como faturamento, preço médio, CMV, resultado por categoria, marca, produto. Avaliar a estrutura física das lojas (identidade visual, planograma, vitrine...etc), qualidade do atendimento, sistemas de TI e nível de serviço em geral. Sinalizar para o franqueado gaps identificados e buscar reversão destes pontos e melhoria a curto prazo.

Ser a interface entre o franqueado e demais unidades de negócio da franqueadora, visando minimizar conflitos, crescimento dos produtos estratégicos, alinhamento de conduta e execução dos Guides estratégicos e de marca estabelecidos pela franqueadora.
Desenvolver plano de ação em conjunto com o franqueado para aumentar o faturamento da operação, influenciar e apoiar o franqueado na execução do mesmo a fim de um negócio rentável e saudável. Bem como atuar na positivação, incremento de Share e venda dos produtos estratégicos por meio de ferramentas de abastecimento e garantindo acompanhamento do inicio ao fim dos pedidos.
Ser o multiplicador na rede franqueada das estratégias comerciais e operacionais da Franqueadora, auxiliando no crescimento de Market Share de produtos e fornecedores estratégicos, seja através da implantação e desenvolvimento de novos produtos/categorias no ponto de venda ou treinamentos de Stakeholders para melhor execução. Experiência com Dinâmica de Varejo;
Experiência com Gestão em Rede de Franquias;
Experiência com vendas no setor Óptico (Lentes e Visão) será um grande diferencial;
Disponibilidade para Viagens;
Possuir CNH B.

title: Business analyst
description:
Driving lasting impact and building long-term capabilities with our clients is not easy work. You are the kind of person who thrives in a high performance/high reward culture - doing hard things, picking yourself up when you stumble, and having the resilience to try another way forward.
In return for your drive, determination, and curiosity, we'll provide the resources, mentorship, and opportunities you need to become a stronger leader faster than you ever thought possible. Your colleagues—at all levels—will invest deeply in your development, just as much as they invest in delivering exceptional results for clients. Every day, you'll receive apprenticeship, coaching, and exposure that will accelerate your growth in ways you won’t find anywhere else.
When you join us, you will have:
Continuous learning:  Our learning and apprenticeship culture, backed by structured programs, is all about helping you grow while creating an environment where feedback is clear, actionable, and focused on your development. The real magic happens when you take the input from others to heart and embrace the fast-paced learning experience, owning your journey. A voice that matters:  From day one, we value your ideas and contributions. You’ll make a tangible impact by offering innovative ideas and practical solutions, all while upholding our unwavering commitment to ethics and integrity. We not only encourage diverse perspectives, but they are critical in driving us toward the best possible outcomes. Global community:  With colleagues across 65+ countries and over 100 different nationalities, our firm’s diversity fuels creativity and helps us come up with the best solutions for our clients. Plus, you’ll have the opportunity to learn from exceptional colleagues with diverse backgrounds and experiences. World-class benefits:  On top of a competitive salary (based on your location, experience, and skills), we provide a comprehensive benefits package to enable holistic well-being for you and your family.
As a business analyst, you will join a client service team and take ownership of a workstream to solve some of the toughest challenges our clients face.
And these aren’t just any clients—they're some of the most influential organizations around, from Fortune 500 giants to innovative startups. We will expect you to go the extra mile, delivering solutions that solve immediate problems and drive long-term change. And we’ll rely on your judgment and integrity to ensure our recommendations are effective and long-lasting.
You will take on a role that goes beyond advising. You’ll be at the heart of the action—helping to uncover the true challenges behind a client’s strategy and creating actionable plans that drive real change. Working alongside clients and other Mc Kinsey colleagues, you’ll combine research, analyzing data, interviews, and brainstorming to generate fresh insights and breakthrough solutions. Your commitment to our values will be crucial in earning our clients' trust and delivering results that matter.
As you collaborate directly with clients, you’ll help them solve problems, refine strategies, and implement transformations. By equipping them with the tools and knowledge to continue innovating and improving after we’ve left, you’ll ensure the impact of our work endures. In doing so, you’ll uphold Mc Kinsey’s commitment to making a meaningful difference in the industries and communities we serve.
Typically, an undergraduate degree with less than 4 years of work experience; Requirements may vary by country or practice.
Excellent organization capabilities, including the ability to initiate tasks independently and see them through to completion.
Strong communication skills, both verbal and written, in English and local office language(s), with the ability to adjust your style to suit different perspectives and seniority levels.
Proficient in rational decision making based on data, facts, and logical reasoning.
Ability to create work product-focused materials / outputs, which may include Power Point decks, Excel models, articles, or other written deliverables.
Exceptional time management to meet your responsibilities in a complex and largely autonomous work environment.
Ability to work or attend meetings outside of traditional business hours or take on projects with limited or no notice at times.
Ability to travel to and work in varying environments that may be challenging and/or not accessible (e.g., factories, hospitals, mines).

Que tal fazer parte do maior e mais tradicional grupo de intermediação imobiliária do país? Especialistas no mercado imobiliário. Com uma equipe de mais de 10.000 corretores associados, a Lopes não é apenas um intermédio na negociação, mas um parceiro para encontrar a melhor oportunidade para você.

Experiência com vendas ou área comercial;

Veículo próprio e disponibilidade para viagens.

Atuação como PJ;
Ajuda de custo mensal.
Nossa história
A História da Lopes começou em  1935 em uma pequena sala comercial no centro de São Paulo onde um corretor de imóveis incomodado teve a grande ideia de um novo modelo de atendimento, que até então não existia!
E de uma ação simples, mas inovadora, a Lopes, há  87 anos , continuou a sua jornada entre pequenos passos e grandes negócios, se tornando a  líder e referência no mercado imobiliário  e sendo reconhecida como a melhor e maior imobiliária da América Latina.
E a Lopes, desde seu início sempre foi ousada em aproveitar oportunidades e assim sempre inovou e saiu à frente com as melhores soluções de negócios.
E falando em inovações...
A Lopes criou o  Lopes Labs em 2019 , o mais novo laboratório de inovações e tecnologias do grupo. Mais um passo na transformação digital da companhia que rendeu inúmeras oportunidades de aprendizados!
Somamos a expertise da empresa líder em negócios imobiliários com tecnologia, para simplificar processos, entregar soluções personalizadas, empoderar o cliente em sua jornada e garantir a melhor experiência. 
Nos tornamos então,  a mais relevante plataforma do mercado imobiliário ! E a cada novo ano, a Lopes encontra uma nova maneira de se manter no topo, como referência em lançamentos imobiliários.

Pioneira na fabricação de embalagens PET no país, e 100% brasileira, a Engepack possui a maior e mais moderna fábrica de preformas PET do Brasil que, aliada à capacitação e à experiência de seu corpo técnico, fornece soluções competitivas e inovadoras para seus clientes em todo o território nacional.  Conhecimento em Excel, Power BI, Canva são desejáveis;

Trabalhar na Engepack é fazer parte de uma equipe que acredita em pessoas, em propósito e em crescimento conjunto. Aqui, valorizamos quem faz acontecer todos os dias, com comprometimento, colaboração e vontade de ir além .

description:
Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!AIdioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online:você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco.Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*O que oferecemos?Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
Acesso exclusivo auma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeosde treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis,com vídeos totalmente atualizados.
Mentorias semanaiscom especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
Plataformaexclusivapara acompanhamento das aulas.
Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.Necessário:Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanaispara treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.O diferencial?Aqui você é mais que um professor.Você será parte deuma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.Estanão é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, aiicom certeza é o seu lugar.Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas.Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!O que eu faço?Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/asSe você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.

Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.Seja diferente, seja independente

description:
Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!AIdioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online:você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco.Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*O que oferecemos?Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
Acesso exclusivo auma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeosde treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis,com vídeos totalmente atualizados.
Mentorias semanaiscom especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
Plataformaexclusivapara acompanhamento das aulas.
Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.Necessário:Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanaispara treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.O diferencial?Aqui você é mais que um professor.Você será parte deuma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.Estanão é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, aiicom certeza é o seu lugar.Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas.Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!O que eu faço?Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/asSe você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Programador ruby
description:
Descrição da Empresa:Oni Learning Technology é uma edtech brasileira cujo objetivo é melhorar a aprendizagem, permitindo que pessoas organizem e criem seu próprio conteúdo educacional. Utilizamos aplicativos móveis que facilitam o processo de aprendizagem, envolvendo professores, alunos e escolas, do ensino fundamental ao ensino superior. Para alunos, Oni Learning funciona como um caderno digital inteligente e interativo, enquanto para professores oferece a criação de material didático personalizado. As instituições educacionais economizam custos e aprimoram a qualidade da educação com o uso de Oni Learning. Juntem-se a nós nessa revolução educacional!Descrição do Cargo:Estamos buscando um Programador Ruby para integrar nossa equipe. Este cargo envolve desenvolver, manter e melhorar nossas aplicações Ruby, colaborando com outros desenvolvedores e equipes de produto para entregar soluções de alta qualidade. O profissional será responsável por garantir a performance e a escalabilidade dos sistemas, além de implementar novas funcionalidades e corrigir bugs. Este é um cargo de tempo integral e remoto.Qualificações:
Desenvolvimento em Ruby:Necessário experiência em programação com Ruby e Ruby on Rails, desenvolvimento de aplicativos web e APIs.
Design de Software:Habilidades em design de software, práticas de codificação limpa e arquitetura de sistemas.
Controle de Versão:Familiaridade com ferramentas de controle de versão, como Git, para gerenciar e compartilhar código.
Trabalho em Equipe:Capacidade de colaborar efetivamente com equipes multifuncionais, habilidades de comunicação e resolução de problemas.
Serão considerados diferenciais conhecimentos em outras linguagens de programação, experiência em metodologias ágeis e formação na área de Tecnologia da Informação ou afins.Interessado? Envie seu currículo diretamente ao nosso head: Paulo Afonso C. Arruda, pelo e-mail: ONIlearning Technology agradece antecipadamente o seu interesse em fazer parte de nosso time de campeões!Paulo Afonso Cardoso de Arruda
Head de Operações e Tecnologia
ONIlearning Technology

title: Desenvolvimento python pleno aws - 124355
description:

Aqui, a diversidade, a igualdade e a inclusão estão no centro e garantir um ambiente de trabalho seguro para todas as pessoas faz parte de quem somos.
Promovemos uma cultura de desenvolvimento e crescimento pautadas no nosso pilar de Continuous Scaled Learning porque acreditamos o uso inteligente da tecnologia é a chave para o sucesso nesse mundo digital.O que estamos buscando?Engenharia de Dados AWS Sênior - ID Requisitos:
Responsabilidades: Desenvolver e manter aplicações complexas em Python, com foco em performance, escalabilidade e segurança. Contribuir com a arquitetura e design de sistemas de grande porte, visando soluções robustas e eficientes. Colaborar ativamente em todas as fases do desenvolvimento de software, desde a concepção até a implementação e manutenção. Mentorizar e compartilhar conhecimentos com desenvolvedores mais juniores, contribuindo para o crescimento do time. Implementar testes automatizados (unitários e integrados), garantindo a qualidade do código. Trabalhar com integração contínua e pipelines de Dev Ops, promovendo a automação de processos. Participar de code reviews, propondo melhorias e boas práticas de desenvolvimento. Manter-se atualizado com novas tecnologias e práticas do mercado, trazendo inovações para os projetos. Requisitos: Experiência sólida de 5+ anos com desenvolvimento em Python. Profundo conhecimento de frameworks como Django, Flask, Fast API ou similares. Experiência em integração de APIs RESTful, microserviços e sistemas distribuídos. Sólidos conhecimentos de bancos de dados relacionais (Postgre SQL, My SQL) e No SQL (Mongo DB, Redis). Experiência com testes automatizados (pytest, unittest) e ferramentas de integração contínua (Jenkins, Git Lab CI). Experiência em ambientes de cloud computing, como AWS, Google Cloud ou Azure. Conhecimento de práticas de segurança em desenvolvimento de software. Familiaridade com containerização (Docker) e orquestração (Kubernetes). Habilidade de trabalhar em equipe e boa comunicação para interagir com áreas multidisciplinares. Capacidade de analisar e resolver problemas complexos de forma eficiente.Descrição comportamental:
Procuramos uma pessoa que:
Goste de trabalhar em equipe e sejacolaborativaem suas atribuições;
Tenhacoragempara se desafiar e ir além, abraçando novas oportunidades de crescimento;
Transforme ideias emsoluções criativase busque qualidade em toda sua rotina;

title: Phd peer reviewer needed: professor of clinical medicine
description:
Note: This is a high-paying part-time job that allows for remote work. Please read the recruitment requirements carefully. Thank you.WHAT YOU NEED to Have
Doctorate Ph D or equivalent advanced degreein the subject area
Published at least 30 papers in SCIE/SSCI/AHCI journals in the past five years
Thorough understanding of research methodologies and ethical principles within the relevant discipline
Excellent analytical and critical thinking skills
Strong written communication skills, with the ability to provide clear, concise, and constructive feedback
Ability to adhere to deadlines and manage time effectively
Commitment to maintaining confidentiality and objectivity
Prior experience as a peer reviewer for academic journals is highly desirable
Familiarity with online manuscript submission and review systemsWHAT YOU WILL DO
Assess Novelty: Evaluate whether the manuscript is original and adds new knowledge or insights to the field of study.
Evaluate Study Design and Methodology: Check whether the study design and methods are appropriate, comprehensive, and clearly described to ensure reproducibility.
Literature Review: Ensure the manuscript thoroughly incorporates and cites relevant, up-to-date research in the field.
Analyse Results and Conclusions: Determine whether results are presented clearly and appropriately, and whether conclusions are supported by the data and significant to the field.
Provide Constructive Feedback: Suggest improvements and highlight any flaws, omissions, or ethical concerns.
Recommend Publication: Based on your evaluation, the journal editor will decide whether the manuscript should be accepted, revised, or rejected.

title: Sr. product analyst
description:
About EightpointEightpoint is an internet technology company specializing in the agile development of products and content that address real-world interests, captivating users and driving significant growth for partners. With offices in the United States and Cayman Islands, Eightpoint collaborates with partners globally on the next generation of user-centric offerings. Our flag ship product is a Chromium browser, that provides a powerful and secure way to search the web; and our growing ecosystem includes a portfolio of innovative mobile products. Every product we launch is designed to engage users, enhance daily life, and deliver real-world value. Backed by data and driven by a relentless commitment to quality, Eightpoint moves fast, thinks big, and builds digital experiences that people love.About the RoleWe are seeking a highly skilled Senior Product Analyst to join our team and help drive data-informed decisions to help grow and optimize our browser products. This individual will play a critical role in analyzing user behavior, evaluating feature performance, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver high quality data insights. This role is best suited for a confident self-starter and requires a blend of creative vision, technical know-how, strong communication / presentation skills, and exceptional organizational skills.Key ResponsibilitiesData Analysis, Insights, & Skills
Extract, clean, and analyze data using SQL to understand product performance, user behavior, and business trends
Proficient at using / analyzing excel, dashboards, reports, and KPIs to monitor product health/performance
Understands what constitutes “accuracy” for various data sets and can run checks to verify the accuracy of a data set
Automatically goes the “extra step” on assigned tasks.
Able to provide actionable recommendations to product managers and leadership teams
Capable of providing clear and concise write-ups for complex analysis
Capable of performing tasks with speed and efficiencyPersonality Traits
People excel in this position that are self – starters, confident, and competitive
They are capable of self-management and independent decision making
They have strong time/priority management skills
They are team players and can see problems from multiple points of view.Cross-Functional Collaboration & Communication
Work closely with Product Managers, Engineering, QA’s, User Acquisition, and Design teams to translate business requirements into analytical solutions
Partner with stakeholders to identify key metrics and measure the success of product initiatives
Understands the differences between team level updates and executive level updatesExperimentation & Optimization
Support A/B testing and experimentation frameworks to validate hypotheses and inform product decisions
Analyze experiment results and recommend next steps for product improvementsAgile/Scrum Processes
Participate in sprint planning, retrospectives, and daily stand-ups to align analytics work with product development priorities
Deliver insights in iterative cycles that align with Agile methodologiesWho You AreBachelor’s degree in a quantitative field (e.g., Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics, or similar)
5+ years of firsthand experience in management/analysis of data within a Structured Query Language (SQL) database (Preferred: Microsoft SQL Server, Amazon Redshift) with proven SQL and query writing skills
Experience collecting and analyzing data and reporting on the results using Excel or a statistical software package
Demonstrated ability to extract and assimilate data from multiple sources and communicate analysis in a concise, easy-to-understand, and actionable format
Strong proficiency in SQL for data manipulation and analysis
Solid understanding of Agile/Scrum frameworks and working in iterative development cycles
Ability to communicate complex findings clearly to technical and non-technical audiences

title: Customer success specialist, life sciences
description:
Jo VE is the world- leading producer and provider of video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use Jo VE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as Harvard, MIT, Yale and Stanford. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.The RoleAs a Customer Success Specialist, you will help professors at leading universities in the US integrate Jo VE videos into their courses to improve teaching outcomes and student success. You'll play a key role in ensuring users get the most value from their Jo VE subscription.Responsibilities:Conduct daily outreach to Faculty (via calls, emails, and 1:1 demos) to set up Jo VE integrations in courses and increase product usage.
Increase Jo VE adoption by delivering product awareness sessions across existing customer universities and research institutes.
Grow engagement and usage by delivering presentations at (1) exhibits and conferences, (2) university seminars and workshops, and (3) onsite customer visits.
Strengthen subscription renewal outcomes by ensuring smooth implementation support, and consistent usage of Jo VE resources.
Influence product decisions by communicating customer feedback to sales, product, and marketing teams.Requirements:A Master's degree or Ph D in Life Science disciplines.
1-3 years of experience in customer facing roles is preferred.
Fluent communication skills English.
Knowledge of education, market trends, and challenges in assigned content areas i.e. Biology, Chemistry, Medicine, Physics, Engineering, or Psychology.
Strong interpersonal skills with a passion for remote relationship-building.
Experience in networking using cold calling is preferred.Please share your resume in English.Why Join Jo VE?You can expect compensation packages competitively placed within the local market.
You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and in improving student learning in science education.
Opportunity to work with global teams and in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration.
Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us.

title: Sailpoint developer
description:
Job Title: Sail Point DeveloperJob Location
Remote / Hybrid / Onsite (as applicable)Experience
6–10+ years overall IAM experience
4–8+ years hands-on Sail Point developmentJob Description Summary
We are seeking aSail Point Developerwith strong hands-on experience in designing, developing, and implementingIdentity and Access Management (IAM)solutions using Sail Point (Identity IQ and/or Identity Now). The role is focused oncustom development, integrations, workflows, and automation , not platform administration or access provisioning support.
The ideal candidate will work closely with security, application, and infrastructure teams to deliver scalable IAM solutions aligned with enterprise security and compliance requirements.Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, and implement Sail Point IAM solutions (Identity IQ and/or Identity Now)
Develop and customizeworkflows, rules, connectors, and lifecycle events
Build and maintaincustom integrationsbetween Sail Point and target systems (REST, SOAP, JDBC, LDAP, AD, Azure AD, etc.)
Developcustom provisioning logic , aggregation rules, and identity correlation logic
Implementaccess request, approval, and certification processes
Customize Sail Point UI components, forms, and reports as required
Develop and maintainpolicies, roles, entitlements, and governance models
Supportuser lifecycle management(Joiner–Mover–Leaver)
Perform unit testing, debugging, and performance tuning of Sail Point solutions
Participate in IAM solution design discussions and technical architecture reviews
Provide technical documentation and knowledge transfer
Collaborate with Dev Ops and security teams for deployments and upgrades
Support Sail Point upgrades and migrations (e.g., IIQ versions or IIQ → Identity Now)Required Technical Skills
Strong hands-on experience withSail Point Identity IQ and/or Identity Now
Proficiency inJava, Bean Shell, Java Script
Experience developingSail Point rules(Aggregation, Provisioning, Correlation, Validation, Certification)
Strong experience withSail Point workflows
Experience withREST/SOAP APIs , JSON, XML
Knowledge ofIAM concepts : authentication, authorization, RBAC, access governance
Experience integrating with:
Active Directory / Azure AD
LDAP
Databases (JDBC)
Cloud and enterprise applications
Understanding ofcertifications, access reviews, So D policies
Experience working inAgile/Scrum environmentsNice-to-Have Skills
Sail Point certifications (Identity IQ Engineer, Identity Now Engineer)
Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP)
Experience with Dev Ops tools (Git, Jenkins, CI/CD)
Knowledge of security standards (ISO 27001, SOX, GDPR)
Experience with PAM integrations (Cyber Ark, Beyond Trust)
Scripting knowledge (Python, Power Shell)What This Role Is NOT
❌ Not a Sail Point Administrator role
❌ Not limited to user provisioning or access requests
❌ Not a helpdesk or L2/L3 IAM support roleThis is acore Sail Point development and engineering role.Soft Skills
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
Good communication and documentation skills
Ability to work independently and with cross-functional teams
Security-first mindset

title: Sap advanced business application programming consultant
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.We are looking for " SAP ABAP" Remote in Brazilwho wants to learn and transform his career.In this role you will: (responsibilities)Prototype, design, develop, and maintain Mobile Application Integration Framework and its integration services to support mobile applications such as SAP Service and Asset Manager, SAP Maintenance Assistant, as well as other system-to-system integration scenarios such as S/4 HANA and Asset Performance Management solution integration, S/4 HANA Disconnected Defense, S/4 HANA Last Mile Delivery, S/4 HANA and Business Network Asset Collaboration solution integration etc.
Follow SAP’s development standard, efficient use of SAP ABAP programming model and development tools in development and testing, such as ABAP OO, ABAP RESTful Application Programming Model, BAPI, BAd I, Open SQL, RDBMS, SAPGUI, ABAP Development Tools for Eclipse, Web Dynpro for ABAP, Fiori Elements, SAP Gateway, OData Service, S/4 HANA Private Cloud, S/4 HAN Public Cloud, SAP ERP system etc.
Actively collaborate with product manager to clarify on customer problem, integration feature requirement
Setup and configure necessary S/4 HANA system business processes (Plant Maintenance, Quality Management, Material Management, Inventory Management, Extended Warehouse Management, Work Clearance Management etc), setup necessary test data (Work Order, Notification, PM Confirmation, Timesheet, Service Order, Service Confirmation, Service Quotation, Equipment, Functional Location, Material Master etc), to support the development and test of integration services.
Collaborate with UX designers to ensure seamless and visually appealing user experience following SAP Fiori Design Guidelines when relevant.
Ensure high performance and responsiveness of developed features
Actively collaborate with frontend MDK developers to align on OData Service features and requirement, to ensure seamless integration between frontend and backend.
Conduct thorough testing, including ABAP unit test to fulfill code coverage requirement, backward compatibility, and prevent performance and feature regression with any new development and enhancement.
Actively collaborate with quality engineers on issues reported, debug, identify and fix bugs, short dumps, and performance issues
Provide sufficient documentations on features developed
Collaborate with user assistance developer (technical writer) to provide information on product features developed to be used in product documentation
Follow agile development principles and best practice during development
Participate in daily scrums
Participate in backlog grooming, and able to provide good quality effort estimates
Provide quick investigation and resolution to assigned customer incident from Service Now. Follow standard customer incident support process, ensure timely investigation, proper communication with customer, proper documentation in Servicew Now incident, and resolution of issues within standard SLA based on criticality of the customer incident. Create necessary JIRA issue for tracking, and SAP Note to provide resolution and fixes.
Maintain communication and documentation in English
Maintain proper communication and notification with lead ABAP developer and SAP development manager on vacation or absence to ensure minimum impact to development timeline
What can you expect from us?• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.
• Opportunities to work outside Brazil
• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.What do we offer?TCS Benefits – Brazil:
Health insurance
Dental Plan
Life insurance
Transportation vouchers
Meal/Food Voucher
Childcare assistance
Gympass
TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates
Partnership with SESC
Reimbursement of Certifications
Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training
International experience opportunity
Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools
Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire
TCS Gems – Recognition for performance
Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career PlatformAt TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!#Buildingonbelief

title: Ux/ui design
description:
Olá, somos a ETUS
Somos uma Mad Tech, atuamos na interseção entre marketing, mídia e tecnologia, com soluções que conectam marcas e pessoas de forma estratégica, automatizada e orientada por dados.
ETUS significa Eu Tenho Um Sonho. Nascemos com o propósito de transformar vidas por meio do empreendedorismo, da inclusão e da inovação. Em poucos anos, construímos um ecossistema completo de empresas focadas em performance, mídia programática, inteligência de dados, tecnologia Saa S e otimização de conversão (CRO).
Hoje, impactamos milhões de pessoas, com uma equipe apaixonada por desafios, crescimento e propósito. Aqui, acreditamos que sonhar é o primeiro passo para transformar realidades.
Se você procura um ambiente dinâmico, e já se imaginou trabalhando com um bando de gente incrível, que ama o impossível e está sempre disposta a mudar o jogo, seu lugar é aqui.Estamos em busca de uma pessoa UX/UI Design Pleno para atuar com foco em CRO (Otimização de Conversão), desenvolvendo interfaces digitais estratégicas para sites, landing pages e fluxos de conversão. Essa pessoa atuará em parceria direta com o time de CRO, transformando diagnósticos, pesquisas e wireframes em interfaces visuais consistentes, funcionais e orientadas a resultados.
A posição é indicada para quem entende que design vai além da estética e atua como ferramenta de clareza, impacto visual e performance de negócio.Suas responsabilidades incluirão:
● Criar layouts de alta fidelidade para sites, landing pages e fluxos digitais, com foco em conversão.
● Transformar wireframes de baixa fidelidade em interfaces visuais bem resolvidas, consistentes e alinhadas ao posicionamento das marcas.
● Trabalhar em parceria direta com Estrategistas de CRO, recebendo diagnósticos, pesquisas, copy e direcionamentos que servirão como base para a criação das interfaces.
● Adaptar layouts para desktop e mobile, garantindo hierarquia visual, responsividade e boa experiência do usuário.
● Criar, manter e evoluir componentes, padrões visuais e estruturas de design system quando necessário.
● Atuar simultaneamente em múltiplos projetos e clientes de diferentes segmentos, como bancos, fintechs, Saa S, e-commerce e geração de leads.Requisitos técnicos obrigatórios:
● Experiência sólida com UI Design, especialmente para sites e landing pages.
● Domínio avançado de Figma, incluindo componentes, Auto Layout e protótipos navegáveis.
● Portfólio online com projetos de UI Design (item indispensável no processo seletivo).
● Boa base em UX/UI Design, com foco em clareza, usabilidade e simplificação de problemas complexos.
● Experiência ou familiaridade com design systems e organização de componentes.
● Capacidade de executar com qualidade a partir de orientações claras, mantendo criatividade, organização e alinhamento com o time.
● Autonomia, senso de responsabilidade, comprometimento com prazos e boa gestão de demandas.
● Boa comunicação e abertura para dar e receber feedbacks.Diferenciais desejáveis:
● Experiência prévia com projetos de CRO, testes A/B ou otimização de conversão.
● Conhecimento em Photoshop e Illustrator.
● Uso de ferramentas de IA no processo de criação ou edição de imagens.
● Experiência na criação de sites e landing pages do zero no Figma.
● Interesse genuíno por tendências de design e evolução constante do repertório visual.O que faz a diferença por aqui: Nosso clube PLUS

title: Senior full stack ai engineer
description:
About Us
Founded in 2019 by two best friends, Jon and Eli,XILOset out to revolutionize the insurance industry by solving its biggest challenges. Eli, a brokerage owner, brought invaluable industry expertise, while Jon, an experienced software engineer, saw an opportunity to innovate using technology.
Initially launched as a vertical Saa S solution addressing core quoting challenges, XILO has since evolved into a trailblazing Vertical AI company leveraging the latest AI technology to transform the industry. By layering cutting-edge AI solutions onto its Saa S platform, XILO is driving innovation far beyond its original vision. Having recently closed our Series A funding round, XILO is growing rapidly and seeking talented individuals who want to do career-defining work in a mission-driven startup that’s at the forefront of AI innovation.The Mission
We are looking for a Senior Engineer to replace a key member of our technical team. You will be joining a group working on a revolutionary product designed to completely transform the United States Insurance Industry. This is not just a standard CRUD application; we are building complex workflows involving AI agents and browser-based tooling to modernize a legacy industry.The Role
You will act as a Full Stack Developer with a heavy emphasis on Backend and AI logic. While Python is your primary weapon for new development, you must be versatile enough to tune existing Node.js services and handle frontend requirements in Angular and Chrome Extensions.
We are looking for someone who understandsAgentic Workflows —how to organize AI models to perform complex tasks—not just someone who knows how to make a simple API call to Open AI.Key Responsibilities
AI & Backend Architecture:Design and implement robust backend services using Python. You will lead the development of AI Agents, defining how they interact, manage context, and execute tasks.
Browser-Based Innovation : Maintain and expand our coreChrome Extensionproduct. This is a critical interface for our users.
Service Tuning:Interface with and optimize existing microservices written inNode.js. You don’t need to be a Node expert, but you must be comfortable reading, debugging, and tuning this code.
Frontend Maintenance:implement UI/UX features usingAngular. While the role is backend-heavy, you should be comfortable jumping into the frontend to ship complete features.
Light Infrastructure:Handle very basic deployment or configuration tasks (Dev Ops is not a primary duty, but “infrastructure awareness” is required).What we’re looking for
Seniority:5+ years of commercial software development experience.
Python Mastery:Deep experience with Python for backend development.
AI/Agent Experience:proven experience working with LLMs and AI Agents. You understand the architecture of agentic frameworks (loops, memory, tools).
Note: Specific framework knowledge (Lang Chain, Crew AI) is a plus, but a strong conceptual grasp of how agents are organized is mandatory.
Node.js Proficiency:Ability to read, understand, and patch Node.js environments.Nice to Have
Experience withLang ChainorCrew AI.
Experience building or maintaining complex browser extensions (manifest v3, background scripts, content injection).
Previous experience in theInsur Techor Fintech sectors.
Background in modernizing legacy workflows with automation.
Familiarity withAngular.Why Join Us?
Impact:Work on a product that is actively changing how the US insurance market operates.
Cutting Edge Tech:We are not just talking about AI; we are implementing agentic workflows in production.
Remote Culture:Work from anywhere with a team that values output over hours.

title: Human resources specialist
description:
About the Job
Turn Key is the #1 Offshore Tech Staffing Firm. We expertly manage all the complexities of staffing exceptional offshore developers – covering everything from recruitment and payroll to legal compliance – so our clients can focus on what they do best: building world-class software. Our Turn Key team is expanding rapidly and spans the globe! With over 300+ employees across Eastern Europe and Latin America (including Mexico, Brazil, Colombia, Costa Rica, Uruguay, and Venezuela), we are dedicated to scaling remote software development teams for more than 40 U. S. -based enterprises and startups, such as Ripple, Headspace, R1, Sertifi, Yipit Data, Work Ramp, and Bell Xcel.OurHR Managerwill take a hands-on approach to provide essential human resources support to our LATAM team members and clients. This position is vital for executing our people initiatives, delivering excellent internal customer support, and driving HR functional excellence and process improvement. Responsibilities include assisting with various HR tasks such as driving HR initiatives, being a trusted advisor, providing expertise in talent management, employee engagement, and organizational development, supporting managers in building and optimizing HR functions within their teams, and organizing the company’s various events. The HR Manager will report to the HR Lead and work collaboratively with other members of our organization.Joining our team you will be focusing on
Working as an integral part of the Turn Key HR and Operations team, contributing to the company’s strategy, and attending regular HR team and Company meetings.
Working with the LATAM HR People Partner with employees (conduct regular 1-on-1 meetings), identifying and anticipating conflicts, resolving difficult situations, maintaining an overall positive atmosphere in the teams.
Working with the LATAM HR People Partner to build and maintain excellent relationships with employees in order to deliver the best HR services and demonstrate a collaborative and proactive approach to solving people issues.
Coordinate and administer day-to-day employee life cycle functions, including on-boarding, off-boarding, adaptation, and orientation programs.
Work closely with clients to provide exceptional service tailored to their needs, partner with the HR and Retention Lead to conduct and lead quarterly HR meetings, and act as an HR advisor to support clients and their teams.
Developing and implementing different HR initiatives for the LATAM region.
Closely working with either clients or the HR team members from organizing client events (online, offline if needed), workshops, team buildings etc.
Working with the LATAM HR People Partner on updating existing presentations as needed, as well as maintaining the HR Notion space up to date.
Work/collaborate with core team from different regions in a multicultural environment.Required Skills
A bachelor’s degree in business, HR, or a related field will be a plus
Ideally, 3 years of human resources functions experience. Experience in tech companies will be a plus

Demonstrated ability to work independently and prioritize workloadPersonal competencies

Initiative and creativity

title: Executivo de vendas externas - máquina de cartão - mercado pago - mg
description:

description:
Location : Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
Duration : 9 Months (Fixed-Term Contract), Starting Feb 2026

delay the 10-month timeline.

beneficial.

title: Anti-money laundering manager
description:
About Us
Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.Key Responsibilities:
Implement and maintain AML/CFT and sanctions policies and procedures aligned with Brazilian regulatory requirements and global best practices.
Regulatory interface (inspections, responses, remediation plans)
Conduct customer due diligence (CDD/KYC/KYB) and enhanced due diligence (EDD) reviews in accordance with risk-based methodologies.
Support ongoing transaction monitoring, screening, and investigation of suspicious activities.
Prepare, review, and file Suspicious Transaction Reports (STRs) and other regulatory filings withCOAFor relevant authorities.
Monitor developments in AML/CFT and sanctions laws, and assist in updating internal procedures accordingly.
Assist in the delivery of internal training and awareness sessions on AML/CFT and sanctions compliance.
Conduct periodic risk assessments, ensuring all controls are operating effectively and aligned with the company’s enterprise risk management framework.
Maintain accurate documentation and audit trails for all compliance reviews, escalations, and filings.
Support internal and external audits, as well as inspections or information requests from regulators.
Coordinate with Legal, Risk, Operations, and Technology teams to strengthen compliance systems and data integrity.
Contribute to the assessment and oversight of third-party vendors that support AML/CFT and compliance operations.Requirements:
Legally resident in Brazil.
Senior-level experience (minimum 7 years) in AML/CFT and sanctions compliance experience in financial, fintech, or VASP sectors.
Proven ability to operate independently as part of the second line of defense.
Strong understanding of COAF, Central Bank of Brazil, and CVM regulations, as well as FATF standards.
Proficient in KYC/KYB, transaction monitoring, and suspicious activity reporting.
Bachelor’s degree in Law, Finance, Economics, or related field; postgraduate or certification (e.g., CAMS, ICA) preferred.
Excellent analytical skills, professional integrity, and fluency in Portuguese and English.
Must meet fit and proper standards with no disqualifying factors, including:
not to have been declared bankrupt or insolvent;
unblemished reputation;
knowledge of the line of business, the services to be provided and the crypto segment, as well as crypto market dynamics and the risks associated with those activities;
technical capability, compatible with the functions to be exercised.

title: Anti-money laundering manager
description:
About Us
Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.Key Responsibilities:
Implement and maintain AML/CFT and sanctions policies and procedures aligned with Brazilian regulatory requirements and global best practices.
Regulatory interface (inspections, responses, remediation plans)
Conduct customer due diligence (CDD/KYC/KYB) and enhanced due diligence (EDD) reviews in accordance with risk-based methodologies.
Support ongoing transaction monitoring, screening, and investigation of suspicious activities.
Prepare, review, and file Suspicious Transaction Reports (STRs) and other regulatory filings withCOAFor relevant authorities.
Monitor developments in AML/CFT and sanctions laws, and assist in updating internal procedures accordingly.
Assist in the delivery of internal training and awareness sessions on AML/CFT and sanctions compliance.
Conduct periodic risk assessments, ensuring all controls are operating effectively and aligned with the company’s enterprise risk management framework.
Maintain accurate documentation and audit trails for all compliance reviews, escalations, and filings.
Support internal and external audits, as well as inspections or information requests from regulators.
Coordinate with Legal, Risk, Operations, and Technology teams to strengthen compliance systems and data integrity.
Contribute to the assessment and oversight of third-party vendors that support AML/CFT and compliance operations.Requirements:
Legally resident in Brazil.
Senior-level experience (minimum 7 years) in AML/CFT and sanctions compliance experience in financial, fintech, or VASP sectors.
Proven ability to operate independently as part of the second line of defense.
Strong understanding of COAF, Central Bank of Brazil, and CVM regulations, as well as FATF standards.
Proficient in KYC/KYB, transaction monitoring, and suspicious activity reporting.
Bachelor’s degree in Law, Finance, Economics, or related field; postgraduate or certification (e.g., CAMS, ICA) preferred.
Excellent analytical skills, professional integrity, and fluency in Portuguese and English.
Must meet fit and proper standards with no disqualifying factors, including:
not to have been declared bankrupt or insolvent;
unblemished reputation;
knowledge of the line of business, the services to be provided and the crypto segment, as well as crypto market dynamics and the risks associated with those activities;
technical capability, compatible with the functions to be exercised.

description:

title: Sales manager -  nutraceutical ingredients ( latam)
description:
Sales Manager - Nutraceutical Ingredients ( LATAM)Location: Brazil (Remote)Territory: Latin AmericaAbout the RoleWe’re seeking a Sales Manager to drive growth across LATAM. You will sell nutraceutical ingredients to the dietary supplement and functional food & beverage industries, building a high-quality pipeline and long-term customer relationships.Responsibilities
• Manage and grow key accounts across LATAM, fostering senior-level relationships with brand owners, CDMOs/contract manufacturers, and distributors.
• Develop and execute country- and segment-level territory plans to capture new business.
• Present nutraceutical ingredients to customers, clearly articulating benefits, applications, and go-to-market plans.
• Collaborate with technical, regulatory, and marketing teams to deliver tailored solutions and product launches.
• Monitor market trends and competitor activity to identify white space and protect share.
• Meet and exceed quarterly/annual sales targets with accurate forecasting and disciplined CRM hygiene.
• Represent the company at regional trade shows, conferences, and industry events.
• Provide technical/product support to customers in coordination with internal teams.
• Maintain up-to-date knowledge of regional regulations and standards (e.g., ANVISA, COFEPRIS, INVIMA).Requirements
• 5+ years of B2 B sales experience in nutraceutical ingredients within LATAM.
• Strong understanding of nutraceutical ingredients and their applications in dietary supplements and functional F&B.
• Proven ability to prospect, build pipelines, negotiate, and close across multiple countries.
• Language: Fluent Portuguese and strong Spanish; English is a plus.
• Self-starter comfortable working remotely; excellent territory/time management.
• Based in Brazil with willingness to travel across LATAM as required.
• Proficiency with MS Office and CRM (ZOHO preferred).

title: Pessoa engenheira de dados  - vaga afirmativa para mulheres cis e trans
description:
A vaga atual é para o escritório do Brasil e trabalhamos em um modelo Free Office.
Quem somos:
Nós da Artefact Lat Am acreditamos e vivemos uma cultura com base na empatia!
Um ambiente de trabalho saudável é um lugar onde todas as vozes são ouvidas, respeitadas e valorizadas.
Temos como nosso compromisso a construção de um ambiente mais diverso e inclusivo, porque a empatia é para todas as pessoas, independentemente de etnia, cor, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou crença religiosa.
Queremos conosco mentes e corações incríveis! Venha ser Artefact!
Quais serão suas responsabilidades:
Você se juntará à nossa equipe de Dados e Consultoria, que ajuda os clientes a transformar e melhorar sua estratégia de dados aplicando análises avançadas para gerar insights que criam valor de negócio a partir de big data e inteligência artificial.
Inovar. Você trabalhará com sua equipe, composta por consultores, cientistas de dados, e engenheiros, para identificar as necessidades dos clientes e definir soluções inovadoras.
Aprender e Compartilhar.Você trabalhará em uma equipe colaborativa que promove o compartilhamento de conhecimento. Você aprenderá com outras pessoas, compartilhará conhecimento e ficará a par das novidades/atualizações do setor.
Desenvolver.Você participará da solução do início ao fim. Com o auxílio de engenheiros seniores, você gerenciará a concepção e a implementação, além de otimizar o desempenho e a escalabilidades.
Atuarem toda a cadeia de valor dos projetos (criação de infraestruturas e plataformas, coleta de dados, aplicação de modelos de aprendizado de máquina, criações de APIs REST, de front-ends, de testes, implementações contínuas).
Popularizartermos técnicos ou soluções para perfis mais orientados a negócios, pode trabalhar em uma equipe com perfis muito diversificados.
Priorizarsuas tarefas, respeitar prazos e se levantar a mão em caso de riscos ou problemas.
O que estamos procurando:Ter cursado graduação em ciência da computação, estatística, engenharia, economia ou uma área relacionada.
Curiosidade: você está sempre buscando soluções inovadoras para seus clientes. Você está envolvido em toda a cadeia de valor, que pode ser front-end, back-end, infraestrutura de big data, modelo de ML...
Colaboração: o compartilhamento de conhecimento é essencial para você e você participa ativamente da difusão de informações dentro da Artefact.
Empreendedorismo: você traz soluções, novas ideias, inovações
O que oferecemos:VR/VT
Free office (trabalhe de casa ou de onde quiser!)
Gympass
Seguros: Vida, saúde e odontológico
Encontros Bimestrais (Famoso “Get Together” onde nos encontramos para estarmos juntos, com oficinas, palestras, treinamentos e aquele happy hour!
Woba (pode marcar para trabalhar em coworking onde quiser!)
Avaliações semestrais (com oportunidade de promoção)
Por que você deveria se juntar a nós:Artefact é o lugar para estar: venha e construa o futuro da área de dados.
Progresso: cada dia oferece novos desafios e novas oportunidades de aprender.
Cultura: Empatia e Colaboração está no nosso DNA.
Empreendedorismo: você se juntará a uma equipe de empreendedores motivados. Não desistiremos até que façamos uma grande diferença nesta indústria!Junte-se a nós!

title: Data engineer - fluent english
description:
The current vacancy is for the Brazilian office and we work in a Free Office model.
Who we are
At Artefact Lat Am, we believe in and live a culture based on empathy!
A healthy work environment is a place where all voices are heard, respected, and valued.
Our commitment is to build a more diverse and inclusive environment, because empathy is for everyone, regardless of ethnicity, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or religious belief.
We want incredible minds and hearts to join us! Come be Artefact!
What you will be doing:
We’re looking for a skilled Data Engineer with hands-on experience in Apache Airflow to join our data team. In this role, you’ll be responsible for designing, building, and maintaining scalable data pipelines and workflows that support our analytics and data-driven products.
Develop , schedule, and monitor data pipelines using Apache Airflow.
Collaboratewith data analysts, scientists, and engineering teams to ensure reliable data delivery.
OptimizeETL processes for performance, reliability, and scalability.
Maintainand improve data architecture, ensuring data integrity and security.
Troubleshootand resolve pipeline failures and performance bottlenecks.
What we are looking for:
A degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Engineering, Economics, or a related field.
Curiosity:You are always looking for innovative solutions for your clients. You get involved in the entire value chain, which can include front-end, back-end, big data infrastructure, ML models…
Collaboration:Knowledge sharing is essential to you, and you actively contribute to spreading information within Artefact.
Entrepreneurship:You bring solutions, new ideas, and innovations.
Fluent English:You are comfortable communicating in English, as it is essential for working in our international environment.
What We Offer:
Meal/Transportation Allowance (VR/VT)
Free Office (work from home or anywhere you want!)
Gympass
Insurance: Life, Health, and Dental
Bi-monthly Meetings (our “Get Together” where we meet to be together, with workshops, lectures, training, and a happy hour!)
Woba (you can book coworking spaces anywhere you want!)
Semi-annual evaluations (with opportunities for promotion)Why you should join us
Artefact is the place to be:come and build the future of marketing
Progress:every day offers new challenges and new opportunities to learn
Culture:join the best team you could ever imagine
Entrepreneurship:

title: Sap basis consultant
description:

Strong knowledge of IT Service Management, SAP Basis and SAP Applications
Hands-on experience with SAP Basis activities, SAP release version upgrades and infrastructure updates for cloud customers
Working experience with SAP HEC, SAP S/4 HANA or any other cloud solution.
Hands-on experience with infrastructure operations, network, interfaces and Load Balancer topics related to SAP landscape management (TLO)
Strong technical troubleshooting skills with the ability to form the solution/designing the mechanism for end to end solutioning
Hands on experience in Migration (onpremise to Cloud/Cross cloud/Cross DC's)Soft Skills
Excellent customer focus / Networking / Relationship Building /Results-driven / Self-organized / Decision making
Excellent communication skills (written and verbal)
Understanding of escalation handling and procedures with customers while proactively working with internal teams towards arriving at a resolution
Experience in working with cross-cultural and cross-functional teams or individuals
Proficiency in English (Written and verbal)Good to have
Cloud architecture and IT technical infrastructure know-how
Knowledge of/certification in one of Azure, AWS or GCP fundamentals
Experience with Migration, Upgrade projects esp. on S/4 H Cloud
Knowledge of Project Management Fundamentals, ITIL, Lean Fundamentals is a plusWhat can you expect from us?• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.
• Opportunities to work outside Brazil
• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.What do we offer?TCS Benefits – Brazil:
Health insurance
Dental Plan
Life insurance
Transportation vouchers
Meal/Food Voucher
Childcare assistance
Gympass

Partnership with SESC
Reimbursement of Certifications
Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training
International experience opportunity
Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools
Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire

Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career PlatformAt TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!#BuildingonbeliefID:

title: Sap basis consultant
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.We are looking forSAP Basis Consultantwho wants to learn and transform his career.In this role you will: (responsibilities)Technical
Strong knowledge of IT Service Management, SAP Basis and SAP Applications
Hands-on experience with SAP Basis activities, SAP release version upgrades and infrastructure updates for cloud customers
Working experience with SAP HEC, SAP S/4 HANA or any other cloud solution.
Hands-on experience with infrastructure operations, network, interfaces and Load Balancer topics related to SAP landscape management (TLO)
Strong technical troubleshooting skills with the ability to form the solution/designing the mechanism for end to end solutioning
Hands on experience in Migration (onpremise to Cloud/Cross cloud/Cross DC's)Soft Skills
Excellent customer focus / Networking / Relationship Building /Results-driven / Self-organized / Decision making
Excellent communication skills (written and verbal)
Understanding of escalation handling and procedures with customers while proactively working with internal teams towards arriving at a resolution
Experience in working with cross-cultural and cross-functional teams or individuals
Proficiency in English (Written and verbal)Good to have
Cloud architecture and IT technical infrastructure know-how
Knowledge of/certification in one of Azure, AWS or GCP fundamentals
Experience with Migration, Upgrade projects esp. on S/4 H Cloud
Knowledge of Project Management Fundamentals, ITIL, Lean Fundamentals is a plusWhat can you expect from us?• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.
• Opportunities to work outside Brazil
• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.What do we offer?TCS Benefits – Brazil:
Health insurance
Dental Plan
Life insurance
Transportation vouchers
Meal/Food Voucher
Childcare assistance
Gympass
TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates
Partnership with SESC
Reimbursement of Certifications
Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training
International experience opportunity
Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools
Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire
TCS Gems – Recognition for performance
Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career PlatformAt TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!#BuildingonbeliefID:
