title: Api engineer
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.We are looking forAPI Designer/Engineerwho wants to learn and transform his career.In this role you will: (responsibilities)Overview
The API Designer/Engineer is a pivotal role responsible for implementing API Design First principles to create scalable, secure, and consumer-centric APIs. The candidate will focus on designing API specifications and frameworks that ensure seamless developer experiences while meeting Customer's API standards and architectural guidelines.Key Responsibilities
API Design & Development
Adopt an API Design First Approach : Leverage Open API (Swagger), RAML, or Async API specifications to define APIs before implementation, ensuring clarity and alignment across stakeholders.
API Specification Creation : Design API specifications that adhere to Customer's API standards, covering endpoints, data structures, error handling, and response codes.
Policy Design and Configuration : Define and configure API policies (security, routing, transformation, throttling, etc.) using tools such as Azure API Management (APIM).
Mock API Development : Create mock APIs for early-stage validation and testing to facilitate integration and feedback before development.
API Testing : Perform unit testing of API specifications to ensure functionality, reliability, and adherence to defined standards.
Environment Configuration : Configure API backend settings within APIM (naming conventions, App Insights, Key Vault) in DEV, UAT, and PRD environments.
API Deployment : Deploy draft APIs into the Azure APIM Dev instance and promote them across DEV, UAT, and PRD environments using the API Dev Ops framework.
Documentation : Create comprehensive API documentation, including references, developer guides, and examples, in line with Customer's standards.
Metadata Publishing : Publish API Identity Cards (metadata, usage information) to the Azure API Management Developer Portal to enable easy discovery and adoption by consumers.API Consumer Onboarding
Secure Authentication Setup : Configure OAuth/Open ID Connect to ensure secure authentication and authorization for API consumers.
Subscription Key Management : Share API subscription keys securely with consumers and maintain robust tracking mechanisms.
Integration Testing Support : Collaborate with API consumers during integration testing to resolve issues and provide guidance on proper usage.Testing & Validation
Functional Testing : Conduct and support API functional, integration, and performance testing to validate API readiness and scalability.
Mock and Staging Environment Management : Ensure availability of mock services and staging environments for API testing and feedback gathering.Skills and Expertise
API Design First Expertise : Proficient in designing APIs using Open API, Swagger Hub, or similar tools with a focus on consumer-first design principles.
Azure API Management : Deep experience in configuring and managing APIs using Azure API Management.
Security Standards : Strong knowledge of OAuth2, Open ID Connect, and API key management best practices.
Documentation Excellence : Skilled in creating developer-friendly documentation and API identity cards.
Testing Proficiency : Familiarity with API testing frameworks and methodologies to validate functionality and performance. Proficient in using Postman toolWhat can you expect from us?• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.
• Opportunities to work outside Brazil
• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.What do we offer?TCS Benefits – Brazil:

title: Strategic executive assistant to the ceo
description:
The VisionAt AI Leadership, we believe in clarity, structure, and well-run operations that allow our team to focus on the work that creates the greatest impact. The Strategic EA role exists to provide end-to-end leverage to the CEO by owning tactical and operational execution: inbox, calendar, logistics, and meeting prep. We are looking for a \"thinking partner\" who can maintain the highest standards of operational excellence and brand representation.Who We’re Looking ForThe Strategic Executive Assistant (EA) will act as the CEO's \"20% focus\" unlock, allowing him to drive 80% of business outcomes. This is not a role for someone who only follows rigid rules; we need an individual who can operate with nuance, anticipate needs before they are stated, and understand the CEO's unique decision-making framework.
You will be measured on your ability to triage the CEO's inbox to 95% without escalation and reduce calendar friction to near-zero. If you are a high-nuance individual who \"just gets it\" and thrives in a fast-paced environment, this role is for you.Why You Should Join UsAI Frontier : Gain direct exposure to the AI space and learn to build and refine AI-driven automation.
Career Growth : We are a growing organization that values internal mobility; this role has a path toward operations or management, as demonstrated by previous incumbents.
High-Impact Environment : Work alongside experienced leaders who prioritize growth, ambition, and proactive problem-solving.Role ResponsibilitiesThe 20% That Drives 80% of Success
Inbox Ownership : Manage the CEO's inbox end-to-end, responding to all messages within 24 hours using his tone and zero \"emotional leakage\".
Strategic Calendar Defense : Own the calendar to ensure it reflects strategic priorities; proactively identify gaps or blockers and coordinate with the family assistant to honor personal time.
Flawless Travel & Logistics : Execute end-to-end travel (flights, hotels, ground transport) and remain on-call for any transit issues.
Meeting Readiness : Maintain prep docs and ensure the CEO is fully prepared for every internal and external stakeholder interaction.
The Remaining 80%
Hub Spot & CRM Maintenance : Review deals weekly, ensure follow-up tasks are executed on time, and load new contacts sourced by the CEO.
SOP & Notion Management : Fully own and update all CEO-related workflows and databases, ensuring documentation is audit-ready and searchable.
Small-Scope Project Management : Lead projects assigned by the Exec Ops Manager, assessing needs, developing plans, and communicating status to stakeholders.Skills & Attributes We're Looking ForMethodical & Nuanced : You understand the difference between tactical execution and strategic decision-making and can operate independently in ambiguous situations.
1–3 Years of Relevant Experience : Ideally supporting senior leaders or working in high-growth, corporate, or communications-heavy environments.
Proactive Tech-Savviness : Proficiency with Google Workspace, Slack, Hub Spot (or similar CRMs), and Notion, plus a strong drive to use AI tools for speed and efficiency.
Executive Presence : You have a professional audio/video setup and communicate with the polish required for CEO-facing interactions.
Coachability : You believe feedback is the \"breakfast of champions\" and iterate quickly based on guidance.Our ValuesCreate remarkable experiences– Every interaction is a chance to satisfy customers and internal team members.
Always be growing– Committed to continuous improvement and individual learning.
Deliver results– Taking initiative to solve problems and drive success regardless of formal responsibility.
Do the right thing– Prioritizing integrity, respect, and discretion in all interactions.
Practice what we teach– Pushing the boundaries of what it means to be AI-driven.
Compensation & LocationCompensation : Starts at $2,200 USD
Location : Remote (Working within 8 AM - 5 PM CST is preferred).Application & Selection ProcessTO APPLY:
Send your Resume(PDF titled \"Lastname. Firstname. EA.pdf\") to (Operations+ ).
Record a short demo video(2 - 4 mins max) highlighting your relevant experience for the role, skills, successes, and goals for the future. Also, we’d like you to briefly mention the following insights:Process Optimization Proposal:Share an example of how you’ve improved an operational workflow in the past (Preferably using AI or automation tools). We want you to showcase your personality, and why you believe you are the ideal candidate for the Strategic Executive Assistant role.

title: Electrical bim lead
description:
At Eracore, we’re committed to developing talented engineers and exposing them to some of the most exciting electrical projects in the country, while becoming the most trusted partners in the industry. From coordination and prefabrication to detailed shop drawings, we support some of the most complex and high-stakes electrical projects in the United States, including Data Centers, Government Facilities, Manufacturing Plants, and cutting-edge Commercial developments.Under strong leadership, Eracore is quickly expanding their presence inBrazil. Our goal is to develop a team of the brightest minds to take on the biggest industry challenges on some of the coolest projects in the USA. of working with us:
Competitive Salary
Annual Bonus
Learning platforms that enable growth and development
Strong leadership and mentorshipRoles and Responsibilities
Oversee and lead the development, coordination, and delivery of Electrical BIM models across all project stages, ensuring compliance with project requirements, standards, and industry best practices.
Manage and guide the Electrical BIM team by providing technical support, quality checks, and mentorship to ensure accurate and efficient model development.
Collaborate closely with multidisciplinary teams (Mechanical, Architectural, Structural, and other engineering teams) to ensure effective model coordination and clash-free deliverables.
Conduct regular model audits, data checks, and quality control reviews to ensure the integrity and reliability of electrical BIM deliverables.
Prepare and deliver BIM-related documentation, including model execution plans, progress reports, schedules, and technical presentations.
Support the integration of BIM with other digital tools such as Navisworks, Revit and clash detection software for enhanced project delivery.
Identify process gaps and propose improvements to enhance BIM efficiency, model accuracy, and team productivity.
Train and upskill team members on BIM technologies, electrical modeling techniques, and emerging industry trends.
Coordinate with client BIM teams to understand project expectations, provide updates, and ensure smooth communication throughout the project lifecycle.Qualifications
2+ years of hands-on experience in Electrical BIM modeling, coordination, and project delivery.
Advanced proficiency in Autodesk Revit (Electrical discipline) with strong understanding of electrical systems
Strong experience using Navisworks for clash detection, coordination, and model review.
Familiarity with BIM 360, ACC, Bluebeam, and other industry tools.
Proven ability to lead, mentor, and guide juniors while maintaining high-quality output.
Ability to manage project timelines and client expectations.Preferrable
Solid understanding of U. S. construction practices, NEC codes, and electrical engineering principle.
Experience in developing BIM standards, workflows, and templates for electrical systems.
Prior experience working on Data Centers.

Arquitetar e desenvolver o backend de aplicações baseadas em LLMs, garantindo que elas sejam rápidas, custo-eficientes e confiáveis.

Para essa cadeira, buscamos um perfil de Engenharia de Software (Backend) com especialização em IA Generativa. Não procuramos apenas quem “consome APIs”, mas quem constrói sistemas resilientes ao redor delas.

Capacidade de desenhar e implementar arquiteturas de RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) que vão além do básico: conhecimento prático de Hybrid Search (Vetorial + Keyword) e estratégias de Reranking (ex: Cohere, BGE) para garantir precisão.

Nossa cultura:
Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 pilares:
⚡ Own It:Ter espírito de dono te faz conquistar a liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo o que entregamos e queremos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio.
Live the Ride:Faça. Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com os erros e encaramos desafios como oportunidades de aprendizado.
No Bullshit:Agir com simplicidade. Somos pessoas práticas, sinceras e gostamos de feedbacks. Sabemos que às vezes vamos errar e contamos com essa transparência para evoluirmos.
Team Play:Se quer ir rápido, vá sozinho(a). Se quer ir longe, trabalhe em equipe. É sempre possível aprender com as outras pessoas e a colaboração é a chave do sucesso.
The Reason:O cliente não tem razão, ele é a razão. Nos motivamos a enxergar o impacto do nosso trabalho na vida do cliente, é vendo que melhoramos a vida dele que sabemos que fizemos uma boa entrega.Como é ser uma pessoa Engineering Manager:
Ser Engineering Manager na Stone significa liderar equipes de engenharia de software, promovendo um ambiente colaborativo e orientado a resultados. É esperado que você atue como facilitador, garantindo que os times tenham clareza de propósito e os recursos necessários para entregar soluções de alta qualidade. Além disso, você será responsável por alinhar as metas técnicas com os objetivos estratégicos da empresa, promovendo o crescimento profissional dos membros da equipe e fomentando uma cultura de aprendizado contínuo. Além de:Liderar e desenvolver times de engenharia, com foco em alta performance e crescimento individual.
Buscar conhecimento sobre os planos estratégicos e operacionais da empresa, propagando e conectando direcionamento técnico alinhado a estrategia;
Garantir a entrega de soluções técnicas alinhadas com as necessidades do negócio, em parceria com PMs, Designers e outras lideranças.

Promover um ambiente de colaboração, segurança psicológica e feedback constante.

Participar da definição e acompanhamento de OKRs e métricas técnicas (lead time, estabilidade, cobertura de testes etc.).
Incentivar iniciativas de Inner Source, uso de RFCs e cultura de documentação viva.
Lidar com problemas ambíguos e priorização desafiadora, equilibrando prazo e qualidade;
Ser influente em tomadas de decisões junto ao time em detalhes de soluções;
Garantir qualidade, escalabilidade e boas práticas do produto/plataforma;
Definir, coletar, analisar e acompanhar métricas de saúde de aplicações/produtos;O que esperamos de você:
Experiência em liderança de times técnicos multidisciplinares baseado em princípios e adoção de metodologias ágeis (scrum / kanban);
Ser um embaixador no time da nossa cultura de alta colaboração e qualidade;
Experiência em ambiente com arquitetura robusta e escalável;
Fortes conhecimentos e experiência em liderança de times adotando padrões arquiteturais e design de código, padrões de codificação consistentes e bem documentados;
Experiência em desenvolvimento Mobile android/i OS;
Sólidos conhecimentos em API RESTful / Protocolo HTTP;
Sólidos conhecimentos sobre algoritmos e estruturas de dados;
Sólidos conhecimentos dos princípios SOLID, Clean Code e Design Patterns;
Experiência em investigações, troubleshooting, telemetria, monitoramento, observabilidade e depuração de sistemas em geral;
Experiência com Teste de Software: Unitário, integração, estresse, mutação e E2 E;
Conhecimentos em bancos de dados e modelagens relacionais e não relacionais, estratégias de cache e processamento distribuído;
Conhecimentos sobre Dev Ops: CI/CD, automatizações e a cultura em si;
Ferramentas de métricas e marketing (e.g. Firebase, Google Analytics, Amplitude);
Experiência em gestão de plataforma mobile (cliente dev interno).O que aumenta as suas chances:

Experiência em desenvolvimento de aplicações com React Native;
Experiência em desenvolvimento de aplicações backend com linguagens Golang, Node e C# ou outra linguagem moderna de backend (adicional);

Experiência com aplicações críticas e de alta disponibilidade.Nossos benefícios:

title: Strategic executive assistant to the ceo
description:
The VisionAt AI Leadership, we believe in clarity, structure, and well-run operations that allow our team to focus on the work that creates the greatest impact. The Strategic EA role exists to provide end-to-end leverage to the CEO by owning tactical and operational execution: inbox, calendar, logistics, and meeting prep. We are looking for a \"thinking partner\" who can maintain the highest standards of operational excellence and brand representation.Who We’re Looking ForThe Strategic Executive Assistant (EA) will act as the CEO's \"20% focus\" unlock, allowing him to drive 80% of business outcomes. This is not a role for someone who only follows rigid rules; we need an individual who can operate with nuance, anticipate needs before they are stated, and understand the CEO's unique decision-making framework.
You will be measured on your ability to triage the CEO's inbox to 95% without escalation and reduce calendar friction to near-zero. If you are a high-nuance individual who \"just gets it\" and thrives in a fast-paced environment, this role is for you.Why You Should Join UsAI Frontier : Gain direct exposure to the AI space and learn to build and refine AI-driven automation.
Career Growth : We are a growing organization that values internal mobility; this role has a path toward operations or management, as demonstrated by previous incumbents.
High-Impact Environment : Work alongside experienced leaders who prioritize growth, ambition, and proactive problem-solving.Role ResponsibilitiesThe 20% That Drives 80% of Success
Inbox Ownership : Manage the CEO's inbox end-to-end, responding to all messages within 24 hours using his tone and zero \"emotional leakage\".
Strategic Calendar Defense : Own the calendar to ensure it reflects strategic priorities; proactively identify gaps or blockers and coordinate with the family assistant to honor personal time.
Flawless Travel & Logistics : Execute end-to-end travel (flights, hotels, ground transport) and remain on-call for any transit issues.
Meeting Readiness : Maintain prep docs and ensure the CEO is fully prepared for every internal and external stakeholder interaction.
The Remaining 80%
Hub Spot & CRM Maintenance : Review deals weekly, ensure follow-up tasks are executed on time, and load new contacts sourced by the CEO.
SOP & Notion Management : Fully own and update all CEO-related workflows and databases, ensuring documentation is audit-ready and searchable.
Small-Scope Project Management : Lead projects assigned by the Exec Ops Manager, assessing needs, developing plans, and communicating status to stakeholders.Skills & Attributes We're Looking ForMethodical & Nuanced : You understand the difference between tactical execution and strategic decision-making and can operate independently in ambiguous situations.
1–3 Years of Relevant Experience : Ideally supporting senior leaders or working in high-growth, corporate, or communications-heavy environments.
Proactive Tech-Savviness : Proficiency with Google Workspace, Slack, Hub Spot (or similar CRMs), and Notion, plus a strong drive to use AI tools for speed and efficiency.
Executive Presence : You have a professional audio/video setup and communicate with the polish required for CEO-facing interactions.
Coachability : You believe feedback is the \"breakfast of champions\" and iterate quickly based on guidance.Our ValuesCreate remarkable experiences– Every interaction is a chance to satisfy customers and internal team members.
Always be growing– Committed to continuous improvement and individual learning.
Deliver results– Taking initiative to solve problems and drive success regardless of formal responsibility.
Do the right thing– Prioritizing integrity, respect, and discretion in all interactions.
Practice what we teach– Pushing the boundaries of what it means to be AI-driven.
Compensation & LocationCompensation : Starts at $2,200 USD
Location : Remote (Working within 8 AM - 5 PM CST is preferred).Application & Selection ProcessTO APPLY:
Send your Resume(PDF titled \"Lastname. Firstname. EA.pdf\") to (Operations+ ).
Record a short demo video(2 - 4 mins max) highlighting your relevant experience for the role, skills, successes, and goals for the future. Also, we’d like you to briefly mention the following insights:Process Optimization Proposal:Share an example of how you’ve improved an operational workflow in the past (Preferably using AI or automation tools). We want you to showcase your personality, and why you believe you are the ideal candidate for the Strategic Executive Assistant role.

title: Chef tournant
description:
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Directs, coaches, supports, supervises, and evaluates (with the Sous Chef) all direct reports.
Must have excellent food knowledge and a full understanding of culinary terms.
Must be able to read, understand, follow, and prepare company recipes by maintaining the quality and consistency in taste according to the instructions provided by the corporate office.

Very strong communication, problem solving, decision making, and interpersonal skills.
Superior customer service, teambuilding, and conflict resolution skills.

Strong planning, coaching, organizing, staffing, controlling, and evaluating skills.

Ability to write reports and business correspondence and to establish a good rapport with the ship’s Senior Officers and the corporate office.

title: Controls engineer
description:
Build the Future of Automation as aRobotics Controls EngineerWe’re looking for aRobotics Controls Engineerwho’s ready to take the lead in designing, programming, and optimizing cutting-edge robotic automation systems. In this hands-on role, you’ll bring bespoke robotic solutions to life, developing advanced control algorithms, integrating real-time systems, and delivering precision, performance, and reliability across industrial robot applications.You’ll work side by side with mechanical, electrical, and production teams to create fully integrated automation solutions from concept to commissioning. From running simulations and performance testing to solving complex control challenges, your expertise will directly shape innovative, high-impact systems used in real-world environments.This is an exciting opportunity for a controls engineer with 3+ years of industrial robot programming experience, a deep passion for automation, and the drive to push the boundaries of what robotic systems can achieve. If you’re eager to make a tangible impact on next-generation robotics, and see your work in action, this role is for you.Key ResponsibilitiesDevelop, implement, and optimise control algorithms for bespoke robotic systems.
Design and integrate control systems for real-time operation, ensuring precise and efficient movement, sensing, and interaction.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including mechanical design engineers, control engineers, and the production teams, to ensure seamless integration into our bespoke robotic automation & control systems.
Conduct simulations and testing to validate control algorithms, mechanical design, manipulator suitability and optimise performance to meet cycle time commitments.
Troubleshoot and resolve control system issues, ensuring smooth operation and reliability.
Stay updated with the latest advancements in robotics controls across multiple vendor platforms and identify opportunities for innovation and improvement.
Document design processes, specifications, and develop technical reports.Qualifications:Bachelor's or Master's degree in Robotics, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
3+ years experience with programming industrial robots is essential.
Strong background in robotics controls and demonstrated experience in developing control algorithms for robotic systems, experience with programming ABB robots is essential.
Familiarity and experience with robotic hardware platforms, PLC programming (Rockwell, Siemens, Omron etc), sensors, and actuators.
Solid understanding of control theory, including PID control, state-space control, and adaptive control.
Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to troubleshoot complex control system issues.
Strong communication and collaboration skills to work effectively in cross functional teams.
Experience with industrial automation, machine vision, or motion planning is desirable.

title: Accounts receivable specialist
description:
About Us:
Vendry is a platform revolutionizing the way companies find, vet, and hire top-performing marketing, web development, and design agencies. By combining cutting-edge technology with human expertise, we streamline the agency search process—delivering tailored solutions that meet each client’s unique needs.The Role:
As Vendry’sAccounts Receivable Specialist , you’ll play a crucial operational and financial role ensuring that our revenue engine runs smoothly, accurately, and transparently. You’ll be responsible for managing our referral fee collection process—working directly with our agency partners to confirm contract terms, validate deal data, and ensure timely and accurate payments.Beyond the core AR workflow, this role is also instrumental in strengthening Vendry’s internal financial operations. You’ll support our accounting processes, help categorize transactions correctly, maintain clean records across our systems, assist with P&L and reporting needs, and identify opportunities to streamline and improve how we operate as an organization.This is a highly collaborative role that sits at the intersection of finance, operations, and partner relations. You’ll be a key part of ensuring Vendry is running efficiently, sustainably, and with complete clarity into our financial performance.Responsibilities:
Manage the end-to-end accounts receivable process, including tracking referral-fee–eligible deals and verifying all contract and payment data with agency partners.
Collaborate with agencies to collect invoices, confirm terms, and reconcile discrepancies quickly and professionally.
Maintain accurate financial records and ensure all transactions are properly categorized in accounting systems.
Support monthly P&Ls, reporting workflows, and ad-hoc financial analysis as needed.
Continuously evaluate and improve Vendry’s internal financial processes, tools, and documentation.
Work closely with the Agency Operations and Leadership teams to ensure alignment between deal data, contract terms, and revenue expectations.
Maintain up-to-date documentation in our internal systems to support transparency, compliance, and decision-making.
Assist with broader operational improvements as Vendry scales—including identifying bottlenecks, proposing solutions, and helping implement them.Qualifications:2–4 years of experience in accounts receivable, financial operations, accounting support, or a similar role.
Strong understanding of basic accounting principles and AR best practices.
Excellent English proficiency (verbal and written) and strong communication skills, especially when working with U. S.-based teams and partners.
Experience working with U. S. startups, agencies, or marketing organizations is strongly preferred.
Comfort working with financial tools, spreadsheets, accounting platforms, and internal operations systems.
Highly organized, detail-oriented, and proactive—able to manage multiple workflows with accuracy and follow-through.
Experience working remotely; able to collaborate asynchronously and manage your own schedule effectively.
Based in Braziland able to work full-time remotely.Why Join Vendry:
Joining Vendry means becoming part of a fast-growing team committed to transforming how brands discover and work with top-tier agencies. You’ll play a foundational role in strengthening the systems that allow our business to scale—helping ensure our financial engine is accurate, efficient, and ready for growth.We’re a collaborative, fast-moving team that values operational excellence, clear communication, and initiative. You’ll have the opportunity to make a measurable impact on how the company runs day-to-day, while building deep experience in finance and operations within a modern, tech-powered startup.

title: Senior software engineer (ai & orchestration)
description:
Company DescriptionA Coru é líder em soluções de experiência de usuário para empresas, focada em desafiar o convencional por meio de sua plataforma inteligente e assistente digital ADI. Oferecemos experiências digitais humanizadas e hiperpersonalizadas, o que aumenta a geração de receita e a eficiência operacional de nossos parceiros.Mais informações: Coru WebsiteJob DescriptionComo Senior Software Engenieer, você irá liderar a arquitetura e o desenvolvimento da nossa plataforma de orquestração de agentes de IA. A sua missão não é \"reinventar a roda\" no que diz respeito aos LLMs, mas sim construir uma infraestrutura robusta, escalável e flexível que integre as melhores soluções do mercado numa experiência de utilizador perfeita. Será uma peça fundamental na evolução da nossa plataforma para um orquestrador de IA de classe mundial.Responsabilidades:1. Arquitetura e Orquestração
Design do sistema: arquitetar micros serviços escaláveis e camadas de orquestração que possam lidar com vários fornecedores de IA e fluxos de trabalho complexos de agentes;
Estratégia de integração: avaliar e integrar serviços de IA de terceiros (Open AI, Anthropic, Lang Chain, etc.), garantindo alta disponibilidade e eficiência de custos;
Desenvolvimento de API: projetar e manter APIs de alto desempenho e arquiteturas orientadas a eventos para dar suporte a interações em tempo real com agentes.2. Full-Stack Development (Node.js/React)
Excelência em backend: criar serviços seguros, testáveis e sustentáveis usando Nest JS e Type Script;
Integração de frontend: colaborar no frontend Next.js/React para garantir que resultados complexos de IA sejam apresentados de forma intuitiva para os utilizadores;
Gestão de bases de dados: projetar e otimizar esquemas de bases de dados relacionais (SQL) para dar suporte à gestão complexa de estados para agentes de IA.3. Produtividade aumentada por IA
Fluxo de trabalho moderno: usar e defender ativamente ferramentas de desenvolvimento baseadas em IA (Cursor, Git Hub Copilot) para acelerar a entrega e manter a qualidade do código.
Evolução contínua: manter-se atualizado sobre as ferramentas e estruturas de IA mais recentes para garantir que a nossa camada de orquestração permaneça na vanguarda.4. Liderança e Mentoria
Visão técnica: fornecer orientação técnica sobre decisões de \"Build vs buy\" relacionadas com componentes de IA;
Melhores práticas: defender código limpo, CI/CD e padrões rigorosos de documentação dentro da equipa de engenharia.Requisitos Técnicos
Experiência: Mais de 5 anos de experiência profissional em desenvolvimento de software;
Backend: Forte proficiência em Node.js e Type Script (experiência com Nest JS é uma vantagem significativa);
Frontend: Sólida experiência com React e Next.js;
Bases de dados: Conhecimento especializado em SQL (Postgre SQL, My SQL ou similar);
Cloud & Dev Ops: Experiência com AWS/GCP/Azure, Docker e pipelines CI/CD modernos;
Ferramentas de IA: Conforto e alta proficiência na utilização de assistentes de codificação de IA (Cursor, Copilot) para aumentar a produtividade pessoal e da equipa.Competências Essenciais
Mentalidade generalista: capacidade de resolver problemas em toda a pilha sem estar vinculado a um nicho específico \"apenas de IA\";
Pensamento arquitetônico: capacidade de projetar sistemas modulares e fáceis de adaptar à medida que o panorama da IA muda;
Orientado para resultados: focado em entregar valor ao utilizador, em vez de projetar ferramentas internas de forma excessiva.Desejável/ Plus
Experiência na criação ou manutenção de fluxos de trabalho ou orquestradores Agentic;
Familiaridade com bases de dados vetoriais (Pinecone, Weaviate) ou arquiteturas RAG;
Experiência com Python (para pontes de serviço de IA específicas);
Compreensão da observabilidade e gestão de custos de LLM.Você tem o perfil para ser um Coru?
Temos a convicção de que o mais importante de Coru são as pessoas, por isso é fundamental que você faça um “Fit” cultural com toda a equipe. Estes são os pilares da nossa cultura:
-Somos Todos Líderes.
-Rendirse jamás!
-El único problema que no podemos resolver es aquel del que no podemos hablar.
-All together: Diversidad de historias y vivencias. Diferentes visiones traen mayores horizontes.Você está #The One?
-Cartão de benefícios flexível Caju
-Salário competitivo
-Convênio médico Alice e odontológico Amil sem coparticipação
-Somos uma empresa \"Remote First\"
-Plano de carreira em uma empresa em rápido crescimento
-Fazer parte de uma empresa de tecnologia que está revolucionando o mercado e melhorando a vida das pessoas em cada interação.

title: Lead wordpress developer
description:
Given that this position requires English proficiency, we are only considering CV's provided in English. Thank you, and we look forward to your submission!About Olly Olly
Ready to roll up your sleeves and help transform local marketing forever? At Olly Olly, we’re blending technology and real-world expertise to empower businesses across the U. S. like never before.We believe small businesses are the backbone of our economy. That’s why we’re on a mission to provide them with tools, strategies, and insights that help them rank higher, generate high-quality leads, get calls and reviews, and, above all, grow sustainably, without the hassle.The Olly Olly platform complements our hands-on service perfectly: it’s no-nonsense, easy-to-use software that helps local businesses streamline operations and contact management, drive leads, stabilize cash flow, and maximize revenue with minimal effort, so they can reclaim their time to focus on what they do best.Our Vision
We aim to be the ultimate all-in-one platform for small business growth, allowing owners to manage every part of their business efficiently and effortlessly.Our journey began as an agency, and we’ve already helped thousands of clients succeed. Now, we’re embracing an exciting new chapter: becoming a Saa S-first company. By combining hard-earned human expertise with AI and automation, we’re creating affordable solutions that give business owners peace of mind while driving measurable success.Why We Need You
We're seeking a battle-testedWord Press Developer & Landing Page Team Leadwho has personally managed the technical execution of high-stakes marketing campaigns with millions of dollars in ad spend.This isn't a role for someone who's built a few landing pages—we need someone who has been THE person responsible for ensuring every pixel fires correctly, every form submits properly, and every dollar of ad spend has a clear path to conversion tracking.You'll lead a team of two Word Press developers, managing multiple concurrent projects while maintaining the exacting standards required when significant marketing budgets are on the line. You'll be the technical bridge between our marketing campaigns (primarily Meta, but across various channels) and our Hub Spot CRM, ensuring flawless data flow and attribution tracking.Core Responsibilities
Landing Page Development & Campaign Execution
Design, build, and deploy high-converting landing pages optimized for paid traffic from Meta, Google, and other advertising platforms
Own the complete technical implementation of marketing campaigns from concept through launch
Ensure pixel-perfect tracking setup across all campaigns, including Meta Pixel, Google Analytics, conversion tracking, and retargeting audiences
Implement and troubleshoot complex tracking scenarios including server-side tracking, UTM parameters, and multi-touch attribution
Optimize landing page performance for speed, mobile responsiveness, and conversion rates
Conduct A/B testing and implement rapid iterations based on campaign performance data
Hub Spot Integration & Data Management
Build and maintain seamless integrations between landing pages and Hub Spot CRM
Ensure accurate lead capture, form submissions, and data synchronization
Implement and validate proper lead source attribution and campaign tracking in Hub Spot
Create custom workflows and automations to support campaign objectives
Troubleshoot data discrepancies and ensure marketing attribution accuracy
Technical Leadership & Team Management
Provide direction and day-to-day guidance to two Word Press developers while remaining hands-on in execution
Manage workload distribution across multiple concurrent projects and campaigns
Establish and enforce development standards, quality assurance protocols, and best practices
Conduct code reviews and provide constructive technical feedback
Create project timelines and ensure on-time delivery of campaign assets
Serve as the escalation point for complex technical challenges
Quality Assurance & Risk Management
Implement rigorous QA processes, before any campaign launch.
Verify all tracking mechanisms are functioning correctly across devices and browsers
Maintain detailed documentation of tracking implementations and technical specifications
Proactively identify and resolve potential issues before they impact campaign performance
Ensure compliance with privacy regulations (GDPR, CCPA) in all tracking implementationsRequired Qualifications
5+ years of professional Word Press development experience
Direct experience managing technical execution of marketing campaigns with $1 M+ in total ad spend
Must have been the PRIMARY person responsible for landing page build and campaign launch (not just a contributor on a larger team)
Portfolio demonstrating high-converting landing pages you've personally built and deployed
Technical Expertise
Proven experience implementing Git-based version control (Git Lab, Git Hub, or Bitbucket) and configuring Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) pipelines for Word Press. Must be proficient in automating deployment across environments (Dev, Staging, Prod) and integrating unit and end-to-end tests into the workflow.
Expert-level Word Press development skills including ACF. Gutenberg, custom theme development, plugin customization, and advanced page builders (Elementor, Divi, or similar)
Deep understanding of Meta Business Suite, Meta Pixel implementation, and Conversions API
Proven experience with Hub Spot CRM integration, forms, and tracking implementation
Strong command of HTML, CSS, Java Script/j Query, and PHP
Experience with Vue JS is a plus
Experience with conversion tracking pixels across multiple platforms (Meta, Google, Linked In, etc.)
Knowledge of Google Tag Manager and server-side tracking implementations
Understanding of marketing analytics, attribution models, and conversion optimization principles
Management & Communication
Demonstrated experience leading and mentoring developers
Exceptional project management skills with the ability to juggle multiple high-priority projects
Clear communication style with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
Comfortable with accountability when significant marketing budgets are at stake
Ability to explain complex technical concepts to marketing team members
Performance Standards
Meticulous attention to detail—one misconfigured pixel can cost thousands in wasted ad spend
Ability to work under pressure and meet tight campaign launch deadlines
Proactive problem-solver who anticipates issues before they become problems
Commitment to continuous learning as platforms and tracking methods evolvePreferred Qualifications
Experience with marketing automation platforms beyond Hub Spot (Marketo, Pardot, Active Campaign)
Familiarity with conversion rate optimization (CRO) methodologies and tools
Knowledge of SQL for custom reporting and data analysis
Experience with A/B testing platforms (VWO, Optimizely, Google Optimize)
Understanding of SEO best practices for landing pages
Certifications in Meta Blueprint, Google Analytics, or Hub Spot
Experience in agency or fast-paced startup environmentsWhat Success Looks Like
First 30 Days
Audit current landing page infrastructure and tracking implementations
Meet with marketing team to understand campaign objectives and conversion goals
Review existing team workflows and identify optimization opportunities
Successfully launch first campaign under your management with zero tracking issues
First 90 Days
Establish standardized QA protocols and documentation for all campaign launches
Implement improvements to team efficiency and project management processes
Build trust with marketing team through flawless technical execution
Identify and resolve any lingering tracking or integration issues
First Year
Lead team through successful execution of major product launch campaigns
Demonstrably improve landing page conversion rates through testing and optimization
Establish Olly Olly's landing page function as a competitive advantage
Develop your team members' skills and create succession planningWhy This Role Matters
When we invest in marketing campaigns, every dollar needs to count. You'll be the person ensuring that our tracking is accurate, our data is clean, and our ability to optimize is never compromised by technical issues. Your work directly impacts our ability to scale profitably and serve more small business owners.Compensation & Benefits
Competitive pay based on your experience.
Flexible work: 100% remote; Monday-Friday, 8:00 am - 5:00 pm EST
Work-life balance: Generous PTO, including 15 vacation days and U. S. holidays.
Growth-oriented culture: Join an inclusive, international, and innovative team where your contributions make a tangible difference.

title: Manager, corporate development
description:
Manager, Corporate DevelopmentPerseus is an Operating Group of Constellation Software Inc. (csisoftware.com | TSX: CSU), a Canadian-based publicly held company. Perseus has over 6,000 employees, across 70+ software business units, operating in 12+ software industry verticals, and located in over 40 offices.Location:BrazilThe Role:
The services to be provided by the Manager, Corporate Development, encompasses building strong strategic business relationships that lead to the sourcing of current and future M&A opportunities for Perseus. These relationships will be formed with software company decision makers (e.g. CEOs, VPs of Corporate Development, founders, and/or owners) of software companies, M&A advisors, and private equity/ venture capital professionals. Success in this role is defined by building and maintaining meaningful relationships that ultimately lead to Perseus’ acquisition of software companies.The process of initiating relationships, maintaining relationships, and ultimately making an acquisition typically takes multiple years. Measurable outcomes, continuous value-add through many M&A conversations/ relationships, and high-quality market research are what ultimately generate successful acquisitions through time.Outcomes:
Develop and manage an M&A pipeline through Salesforce CRM and create market maps to build strong relationships in assigned software industry vertical(s).
Meet and exceed monthly M&A targets, such as meaningful contacts and other measurable M&A sourcing KPIs.
Work both autonomously and with M&A leadership to qualify M&A opportunities with efficiency.
Ensure the lead database is allocated accurately within portfolio verticals.
Effectively qualify opportunities at the top-end of the acquisition funnel to maintain focus for the Portfolio Managers of the business units.Relevant Experience & Competencies:
At least 3+ years of experience in a Business Development/Sales position at a software company or client-facing M&A/finance role within business development, sales, and/or account management. Preference for experience in outbound-focused origination roles.
A clear interest in developing a long-term pipeline of meaningful relationships with prospects as a career trajectory within software investing.
Previous high-performance in Business Development, winning in an autonomous role, or prior success in other walks of life outside professional BD experience, such as entrepreneurship, will be considered.
Advanced verbal and written communication skills, with the confidence and executive presence to speak with CEOs, M&A advisors, corporate development, private equity and venture capital professionals.
Organized, detail-oriented, and able to work variable hours.
Extraordinary work ethic, proactive with a sense of urgency.Other Requirements:
This role will require occasional in-person travel, which may include Canada, the U. S., Mexico, Colombia, Chile, and/or Peru, and can be primarily performed remotely.
